request: Have renderToString() stringify function-valued attributes automatically with toString(), so we can pass browser callbacks straight into data attributes.

source.request: Have renderToString() stringify function-valued attributes automatically with toString(), so we can pass browser callbacks straight into data attributes.
source.settled: Rendering ignores function-valued attributes whose keys start with on and rejects other function-valued attributes unless explicitly stringified.
source.why: Automatic stringification would bypass the rejection that prevents accidental exposure of server-side function code.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
